Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting insurers from having a financial interest in automotive repair facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to insurers having a financial interest inautomotive repair facilities; and adding a new section to chapter 48.18RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.18 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (a) "Automotive repair facility" has the same meaning as in RCW46.71.011. (b) "Insuring entity" means an insurer, including a fraternalmutual insurer, that is licensed to write casualty insurance. (c) "Ownership interest" means the right to control the affairs ofa business, or the right to share in the profits of a business, andincludes a loan to the business when the interest on the loan is basedupon the income of the business or the loan carries more than acommercially reasonable rate of interest. (2) An insuring entity may not have any ownership interest in an p. 1 HB 1620automotive repair facility. An insuring entity that has an ownershipinterest in an automotive repair facility shall fully divest itself ofownership interest by July 1, 2006. (3) The commissioner shall enforce this section.
